renameNameHint: Enter only the name portion. The SiYuan ID and original extension are retained automatically. Leave an individual name empty to inherit the batch prefix.
noAttachments: This document has no local attachments.
quickHint: Saved independently. Quick compress uses these settings without opening a panel.
aspectHint: Preserves aspect ratio. Images are never enlarged.
previewStale: Settings changed. Generate a new compression preview.
previewClickHint: Compression starts only when you click Generate compression preview. Viewing the original does not compress it.
referenceUnavailable: This reference's document is closed or unavailable. Notebook state has not changed.
selectReference: Select a reference to read its document here.
title: Image Compression
byteHint: Default 24: 16 English characters or 8 common Chinese characters. Mixed text shares the budget (English 1.5, Chinese 3). Characters stay intact and UTF-8 bytes also stay within the budget. Sequence, ID and extension are separate.
name: Original attachment
cancelHint: Cancellation waits for an in-flight reference update to finish, then attempts recovery.
retained: Original files are retained for recovery. Workspace disk usage may increase. Old unreferenced files can later be reviewed in SiYuan.
renameHint: Images use prefix-or-individual-name-SiYuanID.original-extension. The batch prefix defaults to image. Set individual names in the table, or leave them empty to inherit the batch prefix. Existing terminal IDs are retained; otherwise a new ID is generated.
interruptedHint: An interrupted task was found. Its unknown operations will not be replayed automatically. Review task details and restore matching references.
busy: An attachment task is already running. Wait for it to finish.
selectAssets: Select at least one available attachment.
invalidByteLimit: The document prefix budget must be an integer between 1 and 120.
invalidFilename: The resulting filename is invalid or exceeds 240 UTF-8 bytes.
filenameConflict: The destination exists or multiple images share the same target name. This item is blocked; existing files were not overwritten.
incompleteScan: The workspace scan is incomplete. Encrypted or unreadable notebooks must be resolved before applying changes.
unavailableDatabase: A native database definition is unavailable. Resolve it before applying changes.
unsupportedReference: A reference cannot be migrated safely.
unsupportedKernel: This SiYuan kernel does not provide the required complete-reference APIs. Update SiYuan; changes are disabled.
unsafeSymlink: A symbolic link prevents a complete, safe workspace scan.
readFailed: Could not read the document or attachment.
ambiguousAsset: The same resource path resolves to multiple files. This attachment is blocked.
missingLocalAsset: The source file is not local. Download it in SiYuan, then rescan.
sourceChanged: The attachment or its references changed. Rescan before applying.
imageTooLarge: Skipped: image exceeds 50 MiB or 40 million pixels.
attachmentTooLarge: Attachment exceeds the 256 MiB memory limit for verified migration.
animatedImage: Animated images are skipped to preserve animation.
unsupportedImage: Only static JPEG, PNG and WebP images are supported.
damagedImage: The image cannot be decoded or encoded.
unsupportedWorker: The local image worker could not start or load its codecs.
invalidCompression: Check quality (1–100), scale (1–100%) or pixel limit (1–100000).
noSavings: Skipped: the result is not smaller than the original.
writeVerificationFailed: The write or reference verification failed. Review task recovery.
restoreConflict: Recovery is blocked: a file or reference was changed or a new reference was added. No newer changes were overwritten.
invalidJournal: Task history is damaged or from an unsupported version. Preserve the file and resolve it before continuing.
refreshNeeded: The document may have changed. Scan again before starting another task.
pngQualityHint: PNG kept in its original format uses lossless optimisation; quality does not apply.
previewHint: Preview one image, then apply the selected settings to the checked attachments.
copiedOriginals: Renaming creates the new attachment and migrates references; the old file is kept for recovery.
